status: frozen before any pilot or fit

sources: NASA/TM-2017-219501 (Jones, Haller & Tong), p. 4: burner 4 % stagnation pressure drop
NASA/CR-2005-213657 (Liew, Urip & Yang), Table 1, p. 10: main burner total pressure ratio 0.96
NASA/TM-2007-214690 (Jones), p. 12: NPSS turbojet example, 5 % burner pressure loss
combustor_pressure_loss.basis: span of cited public design values

sources: NASA/TM-2017-219501, p. 3: HPC nominal polytropic 91 %, N+3 HPC ~2 % below nominal; LPC ~93 %
eta_compressor.basis: span of cited polytropic values, converted to the model's single isentropic efficiency at the calibration engine's rated OPR (43.2)

sources: NASA/TM-2017-219501, p. 3: HPT polytropic 91 %, 1 % higher than the N+2 level (0.90)
eta_turbine_polytropic.basis: span of cited polytropic values; central 0.90 = N+2 level (Trent 1000 predates N+3)

sources: NASA/TM-2017-219501, p. 3: fan polytropic 97 % (geared, FPR 1.3; 'may seem aggressive')
eta_fan.basis: cited polytropic span, lowered by ~0.005 at the top for isentropic at FPR ~1.45

sources: NASA/TM-2017-219501, Table 3, p. 12: FPR 1.7 (NASA CFM56 model) and 1.3 (N+3)

combustor_air_fraction.basis: ILLUSTRATIVE: no page-citable range for the burner-zone air fraction was found; nearest public analogue is secondary (cooling) flow 15-19 % in NASA/TM-2017-219501 Table 3, p. 12. Propagated over 0.70-0.90 and reported as an assumption.

combustor_heat_loss_fraction.basis: fixed by structural argument (P4.5), not varied

sources: data/icao_engine_data.csv CO and HC emission indices (calibration group only)
eta_b.basis: data-derived per mode via eta_b_from_emissions (energy balance; CRECK heating values)

weighting: each split group equal; records equal within a group; modes equal (recertifications and input-twin models share one group weight)

fit.objective: thrust_matched_v5: sum_i w_i e_i^2, e_i = relative fuel-flow error (unreachable row: e_i = 1.0)
fit.optimizer: Optuna TPESampler(seed=42) over FIT_BOUNDS in FIT_ORDER, then scipy least_squares (trf, bounds, x_scale = box widths, diff_step 1e-4) from the best trial

identifiability.diagnostic: profile likelihood: for each fitted parameter theta_j on a uniform grid over its box, re-fit the others (least_squares, warm-started from the neighbouring grid point); D(theta) = n_eff * ln(SSE_profile(theta) / SSE_min), n_eff = number of calibration (group, mode) pairs
identifiability.rule: IDENTIFIED iff D >= 3.841 at both box edges (95 % profile interval interior to the box) AND the interval width <= 50 % of the box width
identifiability.local_check_reported_not_gating: condition number of the box-scaled J^T J at the optimum
identifiability.pilot_consequence: a parameter not IDENTIFIED in the pilot is moved to fixed-with-cited-range or dropped BEFORE the full fit; the full profile is then run on the remaining fitted set

baselines.B0: constant TSFC: per mode, group-weighted calibration mean of ICAO FF / F_target, times the held-out F_target
baselines.B1: F-A rule: nearest-rated-thrust calibration group (ties: mean over tied groups) per-mode mean ICAO fuel flow x (held-out rated thrust / that group's rated thrust)

heldout_metrics.primary: group-weighted MAPE over all held-out rows (weights as in the fit)

acceptance.A1_identifiability: every parameter in the final fitted set IDENTIFIED (full profile)
acceptance.A2_rule: PASS iff primary MAPE_model <= min(MAPE_B0, MAPE_B1) - 0.25 pp; ESCALATE (plan section 9) iff MAPE_model > MAPE_B0 + 0.25 pp; otherwise 'no demonstrated skill' (fails A2, reported)
acceptance.A3_opr_trend: per mode, OLS slope of TSFC_i = FF_i / F_target,i on OPR_i across held-out groups (one point per group: group mean OPR, group-weighted mean TSFC), computed for ICAO data and for model predictions; PASS iff the signs agree in all three modes. Partial slope controlling for rated thrust is reported, not gating
acceptance.A4_informativeness: tests/test_holdout_informativeness.py passes on the v5 CSV

nox: refit the NOx correlation on calibration-group models only (nox_fit_exclude_models = held-out models) and re-run nox_holdout_validation.py on the held-out group

bands_P6_2.method: seeded (42) Monte Carlo, 64 draws, each fixed parameter uniform over its cited range (eta_b per mode over its calibration min-max; xi fixed); for EACH draw the fitted parameters are RE-FIT on the calibration group (least_squares from the v5 optimum, max_nfev 30), then the design point and held-out MAPE are recomputed
bands_P6_2.reported_as: refit-conditioned range bands (P5-P95 and min-max). These are range propagation under assumed uniform ranges, NOT statistical confidence intervals
